The Quality & After-Sales Manager is responsible for ensuring that yachts meet the company's quality standards throughout production, commissioning, delivery, and after-sales service.

The role focuses on identifying and resolving quality issues, managing customer complaints and warranty claims, coordinating repairs, and ensuring that recurring problems are addressed to improve the quality of future yacht builds.
The position requires close coordination with Production, Engineering, Project Management, Service, and other departments to maintain high-quality standards and customer satisfaction.
q: Bachelor's degree or diploma in Marine Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Naval Architecture, Quality Management, or a related technical field.
Minimum 7–10 years of relevant experience in yacht manufacturing, shipbuilding, marine quality management, or after-sales technical services.
Previous experience in a managerial or supervisory role within the marine industry.
Experience working with luxury yachts, superyachts, or complex marine vessels is highly preferred.
Strong understanding of yacht construction, commissioning, technical systems, and warranty management.
Good understanding of FRP/composite construction, hull structures, mechanical systems, electrical installations, plumbing, HVAC, and yacht interiors.
Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, engineering specifications, and inspection reports.
Knowledge of quality inspection procedures, nonconformity management, root cause analysis, and corrective/preventive actions.
Familiarity with marine classification requirements and applicable industry quality standards.
Experience handling warranty claims, technical investigations, and customer complaints.
Strong coordination, problem-solving, reporting, and team management skills.
Ability to communicate effectively with yacht owners, captains, suppliers, and internal technical teams.
Willingness to travel when required for yacht inspections, technical support, and after-sales activities.
r: Oversee quality inspections during yacht construction, assembly, commissioning, and final delivery.
Ensure all work meets approved drawings, technical specifications, company standards, and applicable marine regulations.
Identify quality defects and nonconformities across structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, interior, and finishing works.
Monitor quality checkpoints at different stages of yacht production.
Coordinate with Production and Engineering teams to resolve quality issues before yacht delivery.
Ensure corrective actions are completed and verified within agreed timelines.
Maintain quality inspection records, defect reports, and corrective action documentation.
Manage after-sales service activities, warranty claims, and technical complaints received from yacht owners, captains, and service representatives.
Review reported defects and coordinate technical assessments to identify the cause of problems.
Plan and coordinate warranty repairs, maintenance, and rectification works with internal teams and external service providers.
Ensure after-sales issues are resolved within agreed timelines while maintaining customer satisfaction.
Monitor outstanding warranty claims and follow up until successful closure.
Coordinate technical support for yachts operating in different locations when required.
Maintain proper records of warranty claims, repair costs, service history, and completed rectification works.
Investigate recurring quality defects and after-sales complaints to identify their root causes.
Determine whether defects originate from design, production, installation, materials, suppliers, or commissioning.
Work with Engineering, Production, and Procurement teams to implement corrective and preventive actions.
Ensure lessons learned from delivered yachts are applied to ongoing and future yacht projects.
Recommend improvements to production processes, inspection procedures, and quality standards.
Monitor recurring defects to reduce warranty costs, rework, and customer complaints.
Coordinate final quality inspections before yacht handover.
Ensure all identified defects and outstanding items are documented and resolved before delivery.
Work with Project Managers, Production, and Commissioning teams to ensure yachts meet delivery requirements.
Review punch lists and monitor the closure of outstanding items.
Support sea trials, technical inspections, and customer acceptance activities when required.
Ensure proper handover of quality records, warranty documentation, and outstanding service items to the after-sales team.
Coordinate quality inspectors, after-sales technicians, and service teams to ensure timely completion of assigned tasks.
Work closely with Production, Engineering, Procurement, Project Management, and Service departments.
Coordinate with suppliers and subcontractors to resolve material defects, equipment failures, and installation issues.
Prioritize critical quality and after-sales issues based on safety, operational impact, customer requirements, and delivery schedules.
Conduct regular quality and after-sales review meetings to monitor progress and outstanding issues.
Prepare regular reports on production quality, warranty claims, and after-sales activities.
Maintain an updated tracker of quality defects, corrective actions, and pending warranty issues.
Monitor warranty repair costs and identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary expenses.
Track recurring defects and provide recommendations to management.
Number of quality defects and recurring issues.
Average time taken to resolve after-sales complaints.

d: Calo is an app providing personalized meal plans for busy people through nutritional algorithms, built with love by chefs, nutritionists, and software engineers.

Launched in Bahrain in 2019, we have since expanded to 6 countries, delivered millions of meals to our customers, and are now expanding our mission of making healthy easy to retail and other verticals.
We're on a noble mission to make healthy easy. We think this is one of the most important problems to tackle in our world today. We have global ambitions - no small thinking here.
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the product experience behind how meals get made, tracked, and delivered to subscribers.

The scope spans production planning, logistics, and supply chain systems, across all six GCC markets, with Saudi Arabia as the largest and most complex. It's a wide scope: you'll translate operational constraints, kitchen capacity, delivery fleet, sourcing, into product decisions that directly impact customer experience, and use AI as an extension of yourself to handle the ad-hocs so your time goes to the decisions that matter most.
q: 6-8 years of product management experience, including 2-3 years in operations or marketplace capacity.
A track record of owning complex, multi-stakeholder systems.
Comfortable being on the ground working directly with kitchen and logistics teams.
AI-native: you use AI tools daily in real work, can prototype in Claude Code without waiting on an engineer, and have shipped an AI or agentic feature.
Based in Riyadh or willing to relocate.
Bonus: food, delivery, or subscription-commerce ops experience; familiarity with agentic pipelines.
r: Drive the product strategy and roadmap across all six GCC markets.
Partner cross-functionally to harden the operational fundamentals behind every meal: on-time delivery, production efficiency, waste reduction.
Translate real-world constraints like kitchen capacity, delivery fleet, and ingredient sourcing into product tradeoffs that protect the customer experience.
Build and ship AI-powered tools and agents that automate or augment operational decisions.
Partner with automation engineers and build the systems that allow them to scale.
Understand how operational failures drive churn and prioritize against that.
Getting close to production teams and spending time in the kitchen understanding the operational flows and how the team on the ground operates.
Undertaking customer and competitive research to stay close to voice of customer and market trends.
Like being close to the operational chaos.
Get energy from fixing systems, not just shipping features.
Comfortable with ambiguity and can drive clarity for yourself and others.
Want AI to be core to how you work, not a plugin bolted on top.
Believe good ops is invisible and autonomous: the customer never notices it.

d: M42 delivers comprehensive healthcare services across the full continuum of care; from primary care to advanced specialty treatments. Leveraging cutting-edge health technologies and precision medicine, we ensure the highest standards of effectiveness, efficiency, and patient-centered outcomes. With a global presence spanning more than 480 facilities in 27 countries and a dedicated workforce of over 20,000 professionals, M42 is uniquely positioned to redefine the future of healthcare on a global scale.

Biogenix Labs, our Omics Center of Excellence, is a pioneering facility advancing precision medicine through cutting-edge genomic and molecular technologies. Specializing in Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) and multi-omics research, the lab delivers deep insights into human health, disease, and treatment pathways. As part of M42’s Integrated Health Solutions platform, Biogenix Labs accelerates scientific discovery, supports national programs, and strengthens the UAE’s leadership in personalized healthcare.

As the Variant Scientist will work under supervision of the Clinical Geneticist to accurately analyze and classify germline and somatic variants from genomic sequencing data using in-house software and scientific literature to produce high-quality clinical reports.
q: Phd in Cancer Genetics, Human Genetics, or Biological Sciences.
Minimum of 5 years of related experience in Variant Interpretation.
Ability to research variants of unknown significance using literature searches with detailed annotation and integration of different data types in a timely fashion.

Ability to use and understand external databases and tools such as COSMIC, TCGA, predictive Networks, ASIAN, SEBINI, CARRIE, and INSIGHT and prediction software such as polyphon, SIFT, Mutation Taster, ALAMUT, UCSC Genome Browser, Ensembl Genome Browser, NCBI BLAST.Restricted.
Experience with DNA sequence analysis, next-generation sequencing (NGS) technologies, use of online database entire ecosystem of real-world evidence to deliver real-time, actionable.
Excellent writing and communication skills, organization, and meticulousness.
Understand experimental methods, data analysis methods and inferences that can be applied to both single-gene experimentation and high-throughput analyses.

Understand large genomic datasets, and their computational analysis, integrating protein and genetic interaction data, regulatory data at the DNA, RNA, and protein levels, polymorphism and disease associated sequence variation data, quantitative phenotypic data and drug-target interaction data.
r: Accurately classify germline and somatic variants for Whole Genome/Whole Exome Sequencing, and panel tests.
Utilize a variety of in-house software tools to analyze clinical molecular data.
Read and interpret scientific literature and curate relevant findings in a clear, concise, and precise manner.
Summarize inherited and somatic genetic test results to generate high quality clinical reports.
Perform critical quality control functions for molecular reports that complies with quality management programs and standard operating procedures.
Support improvements for current assays and processes.
Curate variants, genes, and diseases for scientific and clinical relevance.
Develop SOP for variant interpretation; maintain tracking documents in relation to the variant-scoring process.
Collaborate with the Bioinformatician/IT regarding technology needs for new gene tests.
